profile.idiom_rules: consecutive and in this order; any registers R (tag), D (default), X (lea destination); the table index is the cmov destination; 64-bit lea/cmp/sub/cmovae/cmovb (REX.W, register form), 'mov r32,imm32' (B8+r) for the default; the 32-bit byte-truncated gate computation (movzx, 32-bit cmovae) is a different computation and is not matched; the bias directly followed by the cmov, with no default load in the matched bytes, is listed separately (idiom_default_elsewhere) and not surveyed
profile.idiom_text: sub R,bias; mov D32,default; then cmovae D,R (index D) or cmovb R,D (index R); D != R
profile.table_text: lea B,[rip+T]; movsxd J,DWORD PTR [B+I*4]; add J,B; at most 2 'mov QWORD PTR [rsp+d8],r64'; jmp J; any B and J, I = the idiom's result register, T in .rodata
